requirement: Validate an add-dosage command: the antibiotic ID must not be empty, the route must be a defined enum member, the dose text must not be empty or whitespace, and the optional CrCl range must satisfy the shared range rules when it is supplied.

preconditions.text: Validation runs on an in-memory command without database access
The CrCl range is omitted, so the nested range validator is skipped
A CrCl range is supplied and must satisfy the min/max and unit rules

inputs.text: Oral standard dose ('500 mg orally every 8 hours') with a version-7 antibiotic ID
Intravenous standard dose ('1 g IV every 8 hours') with a version-7 antibiotic ID
Intravenous adjusted dose with a 15-29 mL/min CrCl range
CrCl range with min equal to max (30 mL/min)
Oral standard dose with a null CrCl range
Route of administration 999 (outside every defined member)
CrCl range with min 60 greater than max 15
CrCl range with an empty unit

returns.text: Single validation error reported on AntibioticId, RouteOfAdministration, or Dose
Single validation error reported on Crcl or Crcl.Unit

exception_text: No unhandled exception; invalid input is reported as validation errors
